preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 1 for x in [n, k, l, r, sall, sk])
preconditions.description: All input values are positive integers: n (team size), k (top-k members), l (min score), r (max score), sall (total score), sk (top-k total score).

preconditions.expression: l <= r and k <= n and sk <= sall
preconditions.description: Constraints: minimum score ≤ maximum score, top-k members ≤ team size, and top-k total ≤ overall total.

preconditions.expression: n >= 1 and k >= 1 and l >= 1 and r >= 1 and sall >= 1 and sk >= 1
preconditions.description: All inputs are within the stated bounds (1 ≤ n, k, l, r ≤ 1000; 1 ≤ sk ≤ sall ≤ 10^6).

postconditions.expression: len(output_list) == n and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in output_list)
postconditions.description: Output is a list of exactly n integers representing the scores of each student.

postconditions.expression: all(l <= x <= r for x in output_list) and sum(output_list) == sall
postconditions.description: Each score is between l and r (inclusive), and the sum of all scores equals sall.

postconditions.expression: sorted(output_list, reverse=True)[:k] == sorted(output_list, reverse=True)[:k] and sum(sorted(output_list, reverse=True)[:k]) == sk
postconditions.description: When the scores are sorted in non-increasing order, the sum of the top-k scores equals sk.
